_comment: Single source of truth for all distribution entries. Verified 2026-11-11 against the GitHub release v1.2.0 (API: assets + sha256 digests), the downloaded packages (all sums recomputed locally), README.md, site/index.html and https://krocon.de/products/editlicious/. Update this file first, then the manifests (see distribution/README.md).

product.name: editlicious
product.nameNotes: Always lower case, one word – also at the start of a sentence. Identifiers: 'editlicious' (package names), 'MarcKronberg.editlicious' (winget).
product.licenseNotes: App is MIT. Bundled third-party parts are listed in THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.txt inside every package (docs/licenses.md); the logo wordmark uses paths from the Yellowtail font (Apache-2.0).
product.author: Marc Kronberg
product.npmPackageNotes: The editor as a web component (<editlicious-editor>, same engine as WebAssembly), version 1.2.0. A library for web pages – not the desktop app and not an MCP server.
product.contactPublic: GitHub issues (https://github.com/krocon/editlicious/issues). A personal e-mail address is NOT released for public listings – ask Marc.
product.telemetry: none – no telemetry, no accounts, no update pings (product page FAQ)
product.notAnIde: No project view, no language server, no plugin store (product page FAQ).

features._source: Product page and README – use only these statements.
items: Opens and edits huge files: millions of lines, lines with millions of characters; files up to 4 GB (needs roughly the file size in RAM)
Text lives in a rope in the Rust engine; the window only renders the visible lines and columns
Soft wrap (Alt Z) for normal lines; very long lines shown as a window of what fits
Distraction-free: menu bar on Alt, tabs only with a second file, F1 hides everything but the text
Command palette; every function is a command with a shortcut
Several carets (Ctrl/Cmd D, Alt-click), column selection
Selections that grow with every double click (word, snake_case part, path segment, brackets, line, paragraph)
Find and replace with regular expressions, marks for every match in the scroll bar, go to line
Syntax colours from Sublime/TextMate grammars for more than 70 languages, log files and INI included
Thirteen colour schemes (plus the system's), picked from thumbnails
Encodings and line endings detected on load, kept on save; convert from the status bar
Atomic saving: permissions and symlinks kept, nothing half written
Ten word markers that jump (F7), count and stay in 'Copy as HTML'
Copy as HTML with colours, with or without line numbers
Word completion (Ctrl+Space) from the words around the caret and typical words of the language, plus own word lists
Arithmetic where you type: 255/8= shows and inserts 31.875
Colour values as swatches in the gutter (#hex, rgb(), hsl(), 0xAARRGGBB, "ffRRGGBB")
Notices changes on disk; restores open files, caret and scroll position
Record and play back macros and typing scripts; render them to video (CLI 'editlicious render', needs ffmpeg for MP4)
Opt-in AI control via MCP (sidecar 'editlicious-mcp', off by default, local only)
English and German user interface

performance._note: Only quote together with the context: release builds of the engine on a small two-core Linux machine (docs/architecture.md).
items: 1 GB / 10 million lines opened in 1.6 s
first to last line in 5 ms
100 MB single line opened in 0.1 s
10,000 matches replaced in the 1 GB file in 0.4 s

macos.gatekeeperNote: Unsigned: first start via right-click → Open (or System Settings → Privacy & Security → Open Anyway).

windows.runtime: Microsoft Edge WebView2 (installers fetch the bootstrapper if missing)
windows.smartScreenNote: Unsigned: SmartScreen → More info → Run anyway.

linux.requirements: WebKitGTK 4.1 for .deb/.rpm (Ubuntu 22.04, Debian 12, Fedora 36 or newer); the AppImage bundles everything

packageDetails.nsisInstallMode: currentUser; hook windows/open-with.nsh adds 'Open with' entries (HKCU), no default association
packageDetails.macDocumentTypes: Open-with (rank Alternate), never the default app

assets.note: file name has no version – not suitable as a stable versioned URL

checksumsFile: https://github.com/krocon/editlicious/releases/download/v1.2.0/SHA256SUMS.txt (sha256 9d288106949a316b025e2ac8fca0c11b52d6bea678bb273dc1129e754412df43) – its six lines for dmg, setup.exe, msi, deb, rpm and AppImage equal the sums above. Its seventh line names 'editlicious.app.tar.gz' (48b7c811…), a file the release does not have; the asset is 'editlicious_universal.app.tar.gz' (5650d4ee…). So 'sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS.txt' reports one missing file. v1.0.0 had no SHA256SUMS.txt at all.
